sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic facts only: one village of ~400 Bribri, three deaf signers (deceased by 1991), classified 'isolate', 'no definitive influence from any other signed language', 'Hearing population speaks Bribri [bzd], which is structurally distinct from Bribri SL'; no dictionary, grammar or recordings known (p. 2).

sources.note: The only first-hand work on the variety (basis of the ISO code and Glottolog entry). It is a wordlist/lexicostatistical comparison with LESCO and Brunca SL and is unlikely to say anything about prosody, but it is the sole primary source and should be checked once to close the question.
